name: print-social-purple-ticketing-brand-post-set-with-crown-of-thorns-and-portraits
title: Purple 'Social Media Designs' cover with a fan of tilted post cards showing thorn crown, portraits and stickers
whatItIs: A deep purple gradient cover with a small logo, a large white and yellow 'Social Media Designs' title, a yellow 'Ticketsdeck' pill, a semicircle fan of tilted white and purple post cards with photos of smiling people and a crown of thorns, sparkles and a designer credit pill at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Energetic and celebratory; a fanned card arc makes a body of work feel abundant.
techniques: Fan tilted post cards in an arc.
Highlight the client in a yellow pill.

vocabulary.definition: Cards tilted and fanned in a curve.
A capsule with the designer's name.
